text:
maya: Quick sync — we need to lock scope for the Optimize toolkit pilot in next sprint. Primary asks from two pilot customers: 1) automated quantization recommendations per model/workload, 2) eval-triggered alerts when quality regresses, 3) batching/caching presets for mobile-heavy workloads.

olivia: For quant recs — do we mean full auto (one-click apply) or advisory suggestions?

maya: Advisory + one-click opt-in for beta customers. Want cautious rollout.

ravi: Autoscaling and batching are fine, but mobile tail latency concerns. We should cap batch wait to 15ms for mobile route.

dean: Eval-alerts: recommend threshold-based first (delta from baseline) + sample diffs attached. Can hook into existing eval runner.

olivia: Implementation note: quantization profiles vary by model family. My proposal: surface recommended profile + estimated cost delta + small local test harness (simulate 128 seq).

samir: Customer ops: need a way to opt-out per-tenant and an incident playbook if eval alert fires (false positives will happen).

maya: Agreed. Launch criteria suggestion: (a) recs show >=95% parity on small eval set for 2 weeks, (b) alerts <=1% false positive rate in canary tenants, (c) batching presets deployed with latency SLO verified.

olivia: Prototype config snippet (for discussion):

```yaml
optimize_toolkit:
  quant_recommendation:
    mode: advisory # advisory | auto
    test_sequence: 128
    metrics: [perplexity, exact_match_delta]
  eval_alerts:
    delta_threshold: 0.05
    sample_size: 200
  batching:
    mobile_route:
      max_wait_ms: 15
      max_batch_tokens: 4096
```

ravi: That looks reasonable. Need telemetry hooks (p99 latency, token cost, quality delta) exposed to Console per-route.

dean: We'll need labeled eval prompts to detect subtle regressions — will share a seed set from research.

samir: Customer comms: draft warning copy and support-runbook. I can prepare template.

maya: Action items: olivia to prod a quick spike for quant recs + harness (ETA 1w), dean to share eval seed set (ETA 3d), ravi to validate mobile batching SLO (ETA 4d), samir to draft ops/runbook (ETA 4d). I'll collate for roadmap deck. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: optimize-toolkit/spike-quant -> staging at 2024-11-12T07:12:00Z

olivia: I'll post progress in this thread as soon as spike lands.

maya: Thanks — keeping scope tight for pilot. If anything needs to be dropped, call it out ASAP.
